sidecar_purpose: Repo-resident semantic image sidecar for worker selection, visual continuity, QA, prompt constraint extraction, and later Goldilocks fairytale selection and page planning.
source_truth_note: This sidecar is derived visual evidence for the referenced image. The repo image bytes and package manifest remain authoritative for custody; this sidecar does not authorize derivative images or broaden canon.
runtime_use_note: Use this sidecar for ordinary textual selection, continuity, and prompt planning. Inspect the image pixels directly when exact composition, small text, physical relationships, or fine visual details matter.
do_not_infer_note: Do not infer unseen alternate views, additional story beats, extra props, or acceptance of derivatives beyond the observed scene and stated intended use.

provenance.prompt_unretained_note: Generated by ChatGPT using the OpenAI image gen tool at generation time; the exact prompt was not preserved.

summary: Approved Goldilocks ‘not enough’ scene: a dirty over-the-shoulder view anchors the camera to Patch’s point of view as he studies a tiny vague note while multiple equally plausible forest routes branch ahead. The image visualizes insufficient guidance leaving too many valid next moves.

composition: Landscape forest crossroads scene viewed over Patch’s right shoulder.
Patch’s hood, head, and right shoulder occupy the extreme foreground on one side, creating a strong point-of-view anchor.
Patch’s right hand holds the small note in the foreground, consistent with the visible right shoulder and arm geometry.
The branching paths and many directional signs sit deeper in the frame, creating clear foreground-to-background depth.
The camera perspective deliberately differs from a standard centered mid-shot.
patch_design: Canonical teal hood and antennae are visible in close foreground.
Only the portion of Patch required by the over-the-shoulder composition is shown.
Patch has exactly one left arm and one right arm; the right hand is the hand holding the note.
Patch’s attention is directed toward the note and the route choices beyond it.
props_and_environment: The note is a small physical scrap held by Patch rather than floating in space.
The note carries a deliberately vague instruction/question rather than a detailed plan.
The background is a warm, bright forest junction with many wooden directional signs and multiple usable paths.
Several route markers appear equally plausible rather than one being obviously correct.
scene_semantics: The core metaphor is ambiguity caused by under-specification rather than danger or lack of options.
Patch has enough agency to move but insufficient guidance to distinguish among many valid next moves.
The point-of-view framing places the audience inside Patch’s decision problem.

positive_constraints: Preserve the dirty over-the-shoulder camera angle and strong foreground Patch anchor.
Keep the vague note physically held in Patch’s right hand and keep his attention on it.
Keep multiple plausible routes visible in the background with no single route visually crowned as correct.
Preserve canonical Patch colors, hood, antennae, and simple face architecture where visible.
Use the image as the ‘not enough’ pole of a three-image Goldilocks guidance-balance set.
negative_constraints: Do not float the note independently of Patch.
Do not put the note in Patch’s left hand when the visible foreground geometry clearly exposes his right shoulder and right arm.
Do not add duplicated arms, extra hands, or impossible limb connections.
Do not make one path obviously correct through lighting, scale, signage, or compositional emphasis.
Do not turn the scene into a generic centered mid-shot; the POV framing is identity-critical to this asset.

best_for: Camera-angle reference for subjective Patch POV imagery.
Later fairytale page planning and scene continuity.
QA of the not-enough concept and arm/hand physical logic.
not_sufficient_for: Authorizing derivative images without image QA.
Patch character canon in general; use the canonical Patch reference surfaces.
Exact OCR of incidental small sign text.
